scientific_purpose: Evaluate the actual five-model threshold-margin averaging algorithm on untouched outer folds; separate model, aggregation and decision transfer, repeat fitting seeds, compare matched historical whole-ensemble ranking diagnostics, and assess information value before consuming a twelve-hour submission opportunity.
selection_rule: Freeze all policies and model settings before this run. Report every result; do not pick a new blind payload by the maximum observed result. Positive counts are outputs, never prescribed. Original 77-call payload remains unsent.
limitations: Each outer evaluation excludes all test-group measurements before five-model construction and threshold fitting. Effective model training size is 64 percent of development versus 80 percent for blind deployment; same relative algorithm, smaller evaluation sample. Historical cached whole-ensemble scores are used only for matching retrospective rank-rate diagnostics, never to select nested thresholds. Resampled conditional intervals omit training and protocol-selection uncertainty.
